blocks.text: I can use ‘un’ and ‘une’ to name belongings in French.
You will also learn to recognise and pronounce the sound [un].
Tap each word to see what it means.

items.def: The sound-symbol correspondence [un] is pronounced ‘un’ as in ‘brun’.
A way to categorise nouns as masculine or feminine.

blocks.text: [un] is a nasal sound. It is pronounced ‘un’ as in ‘brun’. Listen, repeat and read these words.
So the sound [un] is also a word! The word ‘un’ has two meanings.

blocks.label: Tap to see the two meanings

blocks.text: In French all nouns, including things, are either **masculine** or **feminine**.
This is called grammatical gender. It is not the same as male or female.

blocks.label: Watch out!
blocks.text: A feminine noun is not always a girl or a woman. A masculine noun is not always a boy or a man. Even things like a pen or a bag are masculine or feminine.
To mean ‘a’ or ‘an’ in French, use {un} before a masculine noun. Un is the indefinite article for masculine nouns.
The indefinite article ‘a’ or ‘an’ for a feminine noun is {une}.
Un and une sound different. Practise saying them: un – une – un – une – un – une.
Both nouns and their indefinite articles have grammatical gender: {un} for masculine nouns and {une} for feminine nouns.

blocks.label: How many ways are there to say ‘a/an’?
blocks.text: Two ways: **un** and **une**. You choose by the gender of the noun.

blocks.q: Which word means ‘a/an’ before a FEMININE noun?
blocks.why: Une is the indefinite article for feminine nouns; un is for masculine nouns.

blocks.q: True or false? Only people and animals have grammatical gender in French.
blocks.why: All French nouns, including things, are masculine or feminine.

blocks.q: Which word for ‘a/an’ goes with each noun? Sort the nouns.
Match the French to the English.

items: [un] is a nasal sound, as in ‘brun’.
Un is also a word. It means ‘a/an’ and the number 1.
All French nouns have grammatical gender: they are masculine or feminine.
The indefinite articles have gender too: un for masculine nouns and une for feminine nouns.
To name belongings, use the noun with the right word for ‘a/an’: un ballon, une peluche.

flashcards.front: How do you pronounce the sound [un]?
flashcards.back: It is a nasal sound: ‘un’ as in ‘brun’.

flashcards.front: Which nouns have grammatical gender in French?
flashcards.back: All of them, including things. They are either masculine or feminine.

flashcards.front: Is grammatical gender the same as male or female?
flashcards.back: No. It is not the same.

worksheet.title: Worksheet: What is it? Naming belongings with ‘un’ and ‘une’
worksheet.instructions: Answer with one word (un or une) or a short phrase. Remember: un goes before masculine nouns and une goes before feminine nouns.

questions.prompt: Fill the gap with un or une: ___ jeu (a game)
questions.explanation: Jeu is a masculine noun, so we use un.

questions.prompt: Fill the gap with un or une: ___ orange (an orange)
questions.explanation: Orange is a feminine noun, so we use une.

questions.prompt: Fill the gap with un or une: ___ stylo (a pen)
questions.explanation: Stylo is a masculine noun, so we use un.

questions.prompt: Fill the gap with un or une: ___ bouteille (a bottle)
questions.explanation: Bouteille is a feminine noun, so we use une.

questions.prompt: Fill the gap with un or une: ___ ballon (a ball)
questions.explanation: Ballon is a masculine noun, so we use un.

questions.prompt: Fill the gap with un or une: ___ peluche (a cuddly toy)
questions.explanation: Peluche is a feminine noun, so we use une.

questions.prompt: Fill the gap with un or une: ___ cahier (an exercise book)
questions.explanation: Cahier is a masculine noun, so we use un.

questions.prompt: Fill the gap with un or une: ___ sac (a bag)
questions.explanation: Sac is a masculine noun, so we use un.

questions.prompt: All French nouns are either masculine or ___. Which word fills the gap?
questions.explanation: Every French noun has grammatical gender: masculine or feminine.

questions.prompt: What does the French word ‘lundi’ mean in English?
questions.explanation: Lundi is one of the words with the sound [un] and it means Monday.
